description: This is a Java class file implementing CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) protection utilities within the OFBiz framework. It manages CSRF tokens for both AJAX and non-AJAX requests, handles token generation, validation, and cache management, and interacts with request paths and session data.

classes.name: CsrfUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for CSRF token management, including generation, validation, and cache handling within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getTokenMap
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the CSRF token map for a user session or party, based on the request and target context path.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a new CSRF token using the configured defense strategy.

methods.name: getRequestUriWithSubFolderLimit
methods.description: Reduces the request URI to a specified subfolder limit for token mapping purposes.

methods.name: getRequestUriFromPath
methods.description: Extracts the request URI from a given path or request URI string, removing query parameters, control paths, and fragments.

methods.name: generateTokenForNonAjax
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a CSRF token for non-AJAX requests, managing token cache and request path considerations.

methods.name: findRequestMap
methods.description: Finds the request mapping configuration based on a URL with control path.

methods.name: findRequestMap
methods.description: Finds the request mapping configuration from a map of request maps and a URL without control path.

methods.name: generateTokenForAjax
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a CSRF token for AJAX requests, stored in session.

methods.name: getTokenForAjax
methods.description: Retrieves the CSRF token stored in session for AJAX requests.

methods.name: addOrUpdateTokenInUrl
methods.description: Adds or updates the CSRF token parameter in a URL.

methods.name: addOrUpdateTokenInQueryString
methods.description: Adds or updates the CSRF token parameter in a query string.

methods.name: checkToken
methods.description: Validates the CSRF token in a request for both AJAX and non-AJAX requests, throwing exceptions if invalid.

methods.name: cleanupTokenMap
methods.description: Removes CSRF tokens associated with a user session from the cache.

methods.name: getTokenNameNonAjax
methods.description: Returns the configured CSRF token name for non-AJAX requests.

methods.name: setTokenNameNonAjax
methods.description: Sets the CSRF token name for non-AJAX requests.

methods.name: getStrategy
methods.description: Returns the current CSRF defense strategy.
